title: Understanding Authorization in MCP
excerpt: Authorization in the Model Context Protocol (MCP) secures access to sensitive resources and operations exposed by MCP servers. If your MCP server handles user data or administrative actions, authorization ensures only permitted users can access its endpoints. MCP uses standardized authorization flows to build trust between MCP clients and MCP servers.
